---
title: "Box Office Numbers"
---

This dataset contains 104 well-known films from 1980 to 2025. The data parameters include approximate budgets, worldwide revenues, runtimes, and ratings. The budget and revenue figures are approximate, rounded values in millions of US dollars and are not adjusted for inflation. The data are intended for classroom exploration rather than research.

The website explore the analyses: [Budget and Revenue](budget-revenue.qmd), [Runtime and Ratings](runtime-rating.qmd), and [The Bond Films](bond.qmd).

Aside from Lecture 10 and 11, I used AI agent Codex for assistance and debugging.
